summary.text: Barry DeKay is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 40 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and rancher, he chairs the Agriculture Committee.

paragraphs.text: DeKay was born in Lynch, Nebraska, and graduated from Lynch High School in 1977.
His career experience includes working as a farmer and rancher.

According to Ballotpedia, he volunteered on the boards of the Niobrara Valley Hospital Foundation, the Niobrara Valley Electric Membership Corporation, the Nebraska Rural Electric Association and the Nebraska Public Power District.
DeKay assumed office in the Nebraska Legislature on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as chair of the Agriculture Committee, vice chair of Natural Resources, and member of General Affairs.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
